walk_forward.note: Anchored walk-forward using calendar_fold_windows (relativedelta months=6), final fold clipped at eval_end

S0.label: CONTROL
S0.description: No per-position stop. Frozen V3 behavior.

S1.label: FIXED_8
S1.description: Hard stop 8% below actual filled entry price. No trailing. No take profit.

S2.label: FIXED_10
S2.description: Hard stop 10% below actual filled entry price. No trailing. No take profit.

S3.label: ATR_3
S3.description: Initial stop = entry_price - 3.0 * ATR20 (20-bar ATR known strictly BEFORE/at entry). Fixed after entry. No trailing. No take profit. No silent clamp.

S4.label: ATR_3_TRAIL
S4.description: Initial stop entry - 3.0*ATR20. Trailing activates only after +1R where R=entry-initial_stop. Chandelier: highest_high_since_entry - 3.0*ATR20 using only previous completed bar. Stop moves UP only, never loosens. No take profit.

stop_execution_semantics.long_stop_trigger: If next bar open <= S then gap-through execute at bar.open (not S). Else if open>S and low<=S then triggered at S using production cost model (spread/slippage/fees).
stop_execution_semantics.activation: Stop becomes active only AFTER entry fill bar; no same-bar lookahead.
stop_execution_semantics.bar_resolution: Daily OHLC (1d) — disclosure: daily OHLC cannot precisely model intraday stop sequencing. No 5-minute fills invented.
stop_execution_semantics.cost_model: Existing production cost model (slippage_bps 2, spread_bps 2, commission 0, effective-dated equity fees, crypto taker 25bps not applicable to equity stops).
stop_execution_semantics.reentry: After protective stop exits a stock: flat until next normal V3 scheduled decision; if frozen V3 selects it again at that future decision, MAY be entered again normally; no same-day automatic reentry; no blacklist; no hidden cooldown. Report reentries within 1 and 2 rebalances and PnL after reentry.

stop_candidates_note: Do NOT grid-search. Evaluate EXACTLY S0-S4. Do not silently clamp ATR stop distance unless predeclared.

R0.label: ALPHA_REFERENCE
R0.description: Existing research/shadow semantics: drawdown events recorded but no permanent drawdown freeze (enforce_drawdown_halt=False). Used only to show unconstrained V3 economics.

R1.label: NEVER_RESET_5PCT
R1.description: 5% account drawdown halt. No automatic reset. Permanent-latch stress case (enforce_drawdown_halt=True, never reset).

R2.label: RESET_5PCT_10_SESSIONS
R2.description: 5% threshold + 10 stable sessions reset. When halt triggers: entries blocked, normal risk-reducing exits allowed, begin stabilization counter. Reset after 10 consecutive trading sessions whose account daily return >=0 (up-or-flat). Reuse exact validated up-or-flat semantics.

account_policy_note: Do NOT test 4%,6%,8%,9% etc. Only R0-R4. Do not mix position stops yet; use frozen V3 S0 for account study.

cost_stress.description: Multiply slippage_bps and spread_bps by cost multiplier; commission/fees scale similarly where applicable.

stop_promotion_rubric.description: A stop candidate is STRONG only if ALL are true. Section 9.
criteria: 1. Worst individual-position loss improves materially: >=30% reduction vs CONTROL
3. Full-period maxDD improves by >=2 percentage points
4. Full-period Sharpe not worse than CONTROL (prefer improvement)
5. Full-period return no worse than CONTROL by more than 5pp OR materially higher via compounding
8. Candidate beats CONTROL in >=10/20 Sharpe folds
9. 3x cost stress does not destroy the advantage
12. Whipsaw does not consume majority of tail-loss savings (net_stop_value = gross_loss_avoided - opportunity_cost - additional_costs must be >0)
stop_promotion_rubric.verdict: PASS only if all true and net_stop_value >0; otherwise NO POSITION-STOP CANDIDATE PASSED

account_promotion_rubric.description: Section 12: reset policy may be candidate only if:
criteria: return cost reasonable relative to risk reduction
median paired fold delta not materially negative
account_promotion_rubric.objective: preserve compounding while avoiding long permanent latches; do NOT automatically select smallest maxDD

interaction_test.rule: Run exactly ONE combined candidate BEST_STOP + BEST_RESET vs pure S0/R0, BEST_STOP alone, BEST_RESET alone. Check complement or duplicate protection. If no clear independent winner, SKIP combined test.
interaction_test.allowed: S?_R? single combination only, no full grid S1xR1 etc

final_verdicts_required: TAIL-LOSS PROTECTION CANDIDATE: <candidate> or NO POSITION-STOP CANDIDATE PASSED
DRAWDOWN RESET CANDIDATE: <candidate> or NO DRAWDOWN RESET CANDIDATE PASSED
COMBINED RISK POLICY CANDIDATE: <stop>+<reset> or NO COMBINED POLICY PROMOTED
